heading: THE EPISTLE OF IGNATIUS TO THE PHILIPPIANS.
paragraphs:
Ignatius, who is also called Theophorus, to the
church of God which is at Philippi, which has
obtained mercy in faith, and patience, and love unfeigned:
Mercy and peace from God the Father, and
the Lord Jesus Christ, “who is the Saviour of all men, specially
of them that believe.”[1932]
